project.name: Cubeage Res
project.summary: Small Cubeage resource and metadata catalog repository that currently owns app identity, icon, and app-store link data in apps.json.
goals: Maintain Cubeage app metadata in a clear source-controlled catalog.
Keep app identifiers, store URLs, and icon references reviewable.
Prevent resource metadata from becoming product-specific application logic.
nonGoals: Do not own the applications listed in the catalog, their store submissions, or their runtime behavior.
Do not own central CI runner, enterprise release bot, platform preview, or deployment behavior.
Do not store secrets, service-specific feature flags, or unrelated runtime configuration in this repository.

owns.name: cubeage-app-metadata-catalog
owns.description: The apps.json catalog of Cubeage app identity, icon, and store-link metadata.

doesNotOwn: Application runtime code, app-store release operations, billing, account systems, or game behavior.
Central Sylphx preview platform, central CI runner capacity, branch protection policy, or enterprise release bot behavior.
Secrets, environment-specific runtime configuration, or service-specific feature flags.
forbiddenCouplings: Do not add application runtime behavior or product-specific feature logic to the resource catalog.
Do not store credentials, private keys, tokens, or environment-specific secrets.
Do not let one consuming application redefine catalog semantics for every other consumer.
Do not encode central release-bot, runner-capacity, secret-management, or branch-protection policy as catalog data.

delivery.deployPath: No CI workflow, package release, or deployment path is currently configured. Catalog updates land through source control and are consumed by downstream projects if they read apps.json.
delivery.productionProof: Catalog changes require syntax validation and a consumer smoke check when a consuming application or service is known. Manifest-only changes are proven by the doctrine project-control audit.

gaps.description: The apps.json catalog is not yet protected by a required syntax or schema check.
Repository has not adopted central ADR-29 stable admission fan-in contexts.
gaps.target: Central CI runner and admission control plane
